backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18 so that more optimizer steps happen in 300 s. Keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 (grad accumulation halves). No other changes.
backlog.title: Smaller total batch 2**18

backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 (grad accumulation of 2 at device batch 64). Many more steps in the fixed time budget; consider lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.03 if unstable, but only change the batch size first.
backlog.title: Total batch 2**17

backlog.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.7 so the LR decays linearly over the last 70% of the time budget.
backlog.title: Warmdown ratio 0.7

backlog.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 to keep the LR high longer.
backlog.title: Warmdown ratio 0.3

backlog.spec: Set FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.05 so the LR does not decay fully to zero.
backlog.title: Final LR fraction 0.05

backlog.spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.03 to add a brief LR warmup and stabilize early Muon/Adam steps.
backlog.title: Short warmup

backlog.spec: Set DEPTH = 6 (model_dim = 384 with ASPECT_RATIO 64; consider ASPECT_RATIO 96 to keep the width at 576 and keep the head dim a divisor). A smaller model gets more tokens in 300 s.
backlog.title: Depth 6 wider-per-time

backlog.spec: Set DEPTH = 10 with the same aspect ratio. Check whether the larger model beats the lower token count in 300 s. Reduce DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE to 32 if OOM.
backlog.title: Depth 10

backlog.spec: Set MATRIX_LR = 0.05 for the Muon parameters.
backlog.title: Matrix LR 0.05

backlog.spec: Set EMBEDDING_LR = 0.4 (down from 0.6).
backlog.title: Embedding LR 0.4

backlog.spec: Set UNEMBEDDING_LR = 0.008, doubling the lm_head learning rate.
backlog.title: Unembedding LR 0.008

backlog.spec: Set SCALAR_LR = 0.25 to calm the per-layer scalar updates.
backlog.title: Scalar LR 0.25

backlog.spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.1 for cautious Muon weight decay. Short runs may benefit from less decay.
backlog.title: Weight decay 0.1

backlog.spec: Make the Muon weight decay scale with the LR multiplier (wd * lr_mult) if it does not already, or otherwise decay it to 0 across training, so that warmdown has no decay pressure.
backlog.title: Weight decay linearly decayed

backlog.spec: Set ADAM_BETAS = (0.8, 0.98) for a smoother second-moment estimate.
backlog.title: Adam beta2 0.98

backlog.spec: Set ADAM_BETAS = (0.9, 0.95).
backlog.title: Adam beta1 0.9

backlog.spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "SSSSL" or "SL" variants. Try "SL", which has more full-context layers, and check whether quality gains outweigh the speed cost.
backlog.title: Window pattern all-long final only

backlog.spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "SSSS", so the final layer stays full anyway if the code forces it. This is faster per step and gives more tokens in 300 s.
backlog.title: Window pattern all short except last

backlog.spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 so there are twice as many heads. Check that FlashAttention and the rotary code handle it.
backlog.title: Head dim 64

backlog.spec: If the logits use a softcap (e.g. 30 or 15), set it to 15. If there is none, add 15*tanh(x/15) before the loss, in float32.
backlog.title: Logit softcap 15

backlog.spec: If the MLP uses relu squared, keep it. Otherwise swap in relu squared with a 4x hidden size. Check that the activation is relu(x).square().
backlog.title: ReLU^2 MLP to SwiGLU-sized

backlog.spec: Make sure the attention output projection and the MLP output projection are zero-initialized. If either is not, zero it. This helps early training stability.
backlog.title: Zero-init projections check

backlog.spec: Make sure the Adam param groups use fused=True and that the training step is wrapped with torch.compile. Remove any per-step .item() syncs or logging that force GPU syncs, except on a few log steps. The goal is to raise throughput within the 300 s.
backlog.title: Disable gradient-free overhead: torch.compile max-autotune off, fused AdamW

backlog.spec: Set DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE = 32 (more grad accumulation, lower memory). Check whether throughput is similar or better thanks to the smaller memory footprint, and whether the saved memory allows a larger model.
backlog.title: Device batch 32 with no accumulation changes

backlog.spec: Shorten the Muon momentum ramp (e.g. 0.85 to 0.95) from 300 steps to 100 steps. If a ramp does not exist, add one from 0.85 to 0.95 over the first 100 steps.
backlog.title: Muon momentum warmup shorter

backlog.spec: If the model has value embeddings, set their LR to 0.5x EMBEDDING_LR. Otherwise skip the value-embedding path on alternating layers only, to test whether it reduces compute without hurting loss.
backlog.title: Untie value embeddings off / lower VE LR

backlog.spec: Scale the initial token embedding std by 0.5 (e.g. normal std 0.5 rather than 1.0) while keeping the rmsnorm after the embedding. This changes the Adam effective step relative to the embedding size.
backlog.title: Init scale of embeddings 0.5

backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**16 (about 65K tokens per step) with DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 unchanged, so gradient accumulation is reduced to fit. This continues the batch-size reduction that gave the largest gain. Leave all other hyperparameters as they are.
backlog.title: Total batch 2**16

backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**15 and DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE = 32 so no accumulation is needed. Multiply MATRIX_LR, EMBEDDING_LR and UNEMBEDDING_LR by 0.7 to compensate for the noisier gradients. This is a bolder step along the small-batch direction.
backlog.title: Total batch 2**15 with scaled LRs

backlog.spec: Make the batch size grow during training. For the first 30% of the time budget use 2**15 tokens per step, then switch to 2**17 for the rest. Implement it by changing the number of gradient accumulation micro-steps based on training progress. Scale the LR by sqrt(batch ratio) at the switch only if training is unstable. Early steps are cheap and noisy gradients are fine there, while the larger batch helps convergence later.
backlog.title: Batch size ramp

backlog.spec: Set DEPTH = 6 and keep ASPECT_RATIO 64 and TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 2**17. The smaller model processes more tokens in the fixed 300 s, which often helps at this scale. Check that model_dim stays divisible by HEAD_DIM. If it doesn't, set ASPECT_RATIO to 85 so dim is 512.
backlog.title: Depth 6 with more steps

backlog.spec: Replace the linear warmdown with a cosine shape over the same WARMDOWN_RATIO of 0.5. Set the multiplier to FINAL_LR_FRAC + (1-FINAL_LR_FRAC)*0.5*(1+cos(pi*p)), where p is progress through the warmdown, and set FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.05. This changes the decay shape, not just the length.
backlog.title: Final LR fraction 0.1 with cosine decay

backlog.spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.1 and multiply it by the same LR schedule multiplier at each step, so it fades to zero during warmdown. Earlier a flat 0.1 gave a small gain of -0.0010. Together with the shorter, noisier steps this may regularize better.
backlog.title: Weight decay 0.1 with decay to zero

backlog.spec: Add an auxiliary loss 1e-4 * mean(logsumexp(logits, dim=-1)**2) to the training loss only. Leave the evaluation path untouched. Compute it from the float logits already produced in the forward pass when targets are provided. This stabilizes the logit scale and can allow a higher unembedding LR.
backlog.title: Z-loss on logits

backlog.spec: Before the optimizer step, call torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0). With small batches the gradient noise is higher, and clipping may help stability and allow a bit more LR. Remove it if it adds a measurable per-step slowdown.
backlog.title: Gradient clipping at 1.0

backlog.spec: Change ADAM_BETAS to (0.9, 0.95) and EMBEDDING_LR to 0.4. With 4x more steps the optimizer can use longer momentum, and the embedding LR was tuned for the larger batch. Make both changes in one run.
backlog.title: Adam beta1 0.9 and embedding LR 0.4

backlog.spec: Lower the final Muon momentum from the current value (likely 0.95) to 0.9, and keep the warmup ramp. With small batches and many steps, lower momentum reduces staleness of the update direction. Edit only the momentum target in the Muon momentum schedule function.
backlog.title: Muon momentum 0.9 final

backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**16 (keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 so grad accumulation divides evenly; if the divisibility assert fails use DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 32). Leave all learning rates unchanged. Goal is more optimizer steps in the fixed 300 s, between the tested 2**15 and 2**17 points.
backlog.title: Total batch 2**16

backlog.spec: After the backward pass of the final micro-step and before the optimizer step, call torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0). Nothing else changes. This stabilizes the small-batch training that the smaller batch size makes noisier.
backlog.title: Gradient clipping at 1.0

backlog.spec: In the training loss only (not in the evaluation path), add 1e-4 * logsumexp(logits.float(), dim=-1).pow(2).mean() to the cross-entropy loss. If the model forward only returns the loss, compute the logits term inside the forward only when targets are given and training. Keep the eval path untouched.
backlog.title: Z-loss on logits

backlog.spec: Change the logit softcap in the model forward from its current value (likely 30) to 15, i.e. logits = 15 * tanh(logits / 15). Apply it identically on the training and evaluation paths so the eval call is not altered.
backlog.title: Logit softcap 15

backlog.spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 so the model has 8 heads at dim 512 instead of 4. Leave everything else unchanged. Check that the number of KV heads and the value-embedding head logic derive from the head count rather than hard-coded values.
backlog.title: Head dim 64

backlog.spec: Make Muon cautious weight decay follow the schedule: wd = WEIGHT_DECAY * (1 - progress), where progress is the fraction of the time budget used. Update it each step for the Muon param groups, using the same progress variable the LR schedule uses. Keep the starting value at 0.2.
backlog.title: Weight decay linearly decayed to zero

backlog.spec: Set ADAM_BETAS = (0.9, 0.95) and FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.05. This is a combined change: a smoother first moment and a nonzero LR floor at the end of warmdown, which suits the high step count of the small batch.
backlog.title: Final LR fraction 0.05 with Adam beta1 0.9

backlog.spec: Set EMBEDDING_LR = 0.3 and UNEMBEDDING_LR = 0.008 together. The embedding LR of 0.6 was tuned for large batches. At 4x more steps, a smaller embedding step and a larger lm_head step may balance better.
backlog.title: Lower embedding and unembedding LR balance

backlog.spec: Multiply the scaled LRs by about 0.7 for the 4x smaller batch, which follows the sqrt rule: MATRIX_LR = 0.03, EMBEDDING_LR = 0.4, UNEMBEDDING_LR = 0.003, SCALAR_LR = 0.35. Leave other hyperparameters unchanged. The LRs were tuned at 2**19 tokens and are never retuned for 2**17.
backlog.title: Scale LRs by sqrt of batch change

backlog.spec: Lower the Muon final momentum from its current value (likely 0.95) to 0.9, and reduce the Newton-Schulz iteration count from 5 to 4 if the code exposes it as a parameter. This allows faster response and cheaper steps, which gives a few more steps in the fixed 300 s. If the ns steps are hard-coded in a way that needs a larger edit, only change the momentum.
backlog.title: Muon momentum final 0.9 with Muon ns steps 3

memo:
Helped: only the batch-size cut. TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 2**19 to 2**17 gave more optimizer steps and moved val_bpb to 1.0522 (delta -0.0624). It carries a tripwire flag, so a replicate or audit is worth a slot.

Did not help (rejected vs incumbent): schedule tweaks (WARMDOWN_RATIO 0.3 -0.0007, 0.7 +0.0045; 3% warmup +0.0109; cosine decay +0.0012), Muon LR 0.05 (+0.0021), DEPTH 6 (-0.0000), DEPTH 10 (+0.0820), "SL" window pattern (-0.0014), beta2 0.98 (-0.0011), weight decay 0.1 (-0.0010), final momentum 0.9 (-0.0007), momentum ramp 100 steps (-0.0017). Batch 2**15 (-0.0010) and the 2**15 to 2**17 ramp (-0.0013) were also small. Those gains are close to noise, since none was clearly better.

Next: audit/replicate the incumbent first. Then combine the small gains (weight decay 0.1, beta2 0.98, "SL", shorter momentum ramp) in one run, possibly with a smaller batch. Avoid more schedule-only tweaks and no-change slots (slots 2, 8, 12 and 14 aborted).
